name: Iron Rattler
description: The most spectacular and beloved roller coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas — Iron Rattler is a legendary RMC hybrid coaster built on the skeleton of the original Rattler wooden coaster, delivering an extraordinary beyond-vertical drop into a quarry wall and relentless airtime through a breathtaking layout. Consistently voted one of the greatest hybrid coasters in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Superman: Krypton Coaster
description: A spectacular and beloved floorless coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas delivering six inversions at 112 km/h over a dramatic quarry landscape. One of the finest floorless coasters in the United States and a must-ride at any San Antonio theme park visit. Min 137cm.

name: Wonder Woman Golden Lasso Coaster
description: A spectacular single-rail coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas — Wonder Woman Golden Lasso Coaster is the first single-rail coaster in the world, delivering an extraordinary riding experience through a unique layout where riders straddle a single rail with legs dangling freely. One of the most innovative and unique coasters at any American theme park. Min 122cm.

name: Poltergeist
description: A legendary launched coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas launching riders from 0 to 107 km/h in 3.8 seconds through a spectacular tightly packed layout of loops, corkscrews and zero-G rolls. One of the most intense and rerideable launched coasters in Texas. Min 137cm.

name: Batman The Ride
description: A classic and beloved Batman-themed inverted coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas delivering five inversions at 80 km/h through a spectacular themed layout. One of the most popular and rerideable inverted coasters in Texas. Min 137cm.

name: Scream
description: A terrifying open-air drop tower at Six Flags Fiesta Texas lifting riders to the top of the quarry wall before plunging them back down at terrifying speed. One of the most scenic and terrifying drop tower experiences in Texas with extraordinary views over San Antonio. Min 122cm.

name: Sky Screamer
description: A spectacular giant swing ride at Six Flags Fiesta Texas swinging riders at the top of the quarry wall with breathtaking panoramic views over San Antonio. One of the most scenic and exhilarating swing rides at any Texas theme park. Min 122cm.

name: The Joker
description: A spectacular free-fly coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas where seats rotate independently through a twisted layout of inversions. A uniquely disorienting and entertaining coaster experience. Min 122cm.

name: Boomerang
description: A classic and beloved boomerang shuttle coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas delivering three inversions forwards and then backwards through the same layout. A fun and accessible thrill coaster for all ages. Min 122cm.

name: Pandemonium
description: A fun and popular spinning wild mouse coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas with freely rotating cars through tight turns and drops. A fun unpredictable family experience. Min 107cm.

name: Tony Hawk's Big Spin
description: A fun and popular spinning coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas themed to skateboarding legend Tony Hawk. Riders spin through a compact layout in fun rotating cars. Min 107cm.

name: Rio Loco
description: A beloved and refreshing river rapids ride at Six Flags Fiesta Texas themed to the Texas Hill Country — riders drift through turbulent rapids and dramatic waterfalls in a fun circular raft. One of the most popular water rides in San Antonio. Min 107cm.

name: Bugs' White Water Rapids
description: A classic and refreshing white water rapids ride at Six Flags Fiesta Texas featuring Bugs Bunny and friends through splashing rapids and fun special effects. One of the most entertaining water rides for families in Texas. Min 107cm.

name: Road Runner Express
description: A classic and beloved mine train coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas featuring Road Runner and Wile E. Coyote through a charming Texas desert landscape. The perfect first coaster for young riders. Min 107cm.

name: Tower of Power
description: A thrilling drop and launch tower experience at Six Flags Fiesta Texas combining upward launches and stomach-dropping falls with spectacular quarry views. Min 107cm.
